neighbours.label: the extracellular matrix of connective tissue (extr|acellular matrix, collagen and proteoglycans, cartilage matrix)
fire: Fibroblasts secrete collagen and other proteins into the extracellular matrix.
Tumor cells can degrade the extracellular matrix and invade nearby tissue.
Cartilage consists of chondrocytes embedded in a matrix of collagen and proteoglycans.
Hyaluronic acid is a major component of the extracellular matrix in skin.
Excess deposition of extracellular collagen leads to fibrosis of the liver.
Integrins link the cell's cytoskeleton to the surrounding extracellular matrix.
The matrix of tendons is rich in type I collagen fibers and proteoglycans.
Межклеточное вещество хряща содержит много коллагеновых волокон.
quiet: Fibroblasts divide quickly when the wound begins to heal.
Tumor cells can spread through the blood and reach distant organs.
Cartilage cells receive nutrients slowly because the tissue has few blood vessels.
Hyaluronic acid is often added to face creams and sold in pharmacies.
Excess alcohol consumption leads to damage of the liver over time.
Mitochondria produce most of the energy that the cell needs.
Tendons connect muscles to bones and help transmit force during movement.
Клетки печени быстро восстанавливаются после небольшого повреждения.
